children.text: This policy explains what information the Santa Barbara Women's Political Committee (SBWPC) collects through sbwpc.org, how we use it and the choices you have. It covers this website and the forms on it. It does not cover other websites we link to.

SBWPC is a California political committee. Some of what we collect is required by California's Political Reform Act, and some of it becomes public by law. We explain that below so there are no surprises.
The short version
We collect what you give us when you donate, join, sign up for email, request an endorsement or write to us.
We do not sell, rent, trade or share our supporter list with anyone.
Contributions of $100 or more are reported to the state by law, and those reports are public.
We use analytics only if you say yes, and we honor Global Privacy Control.
You can ask us to see, correct or delete your information at any time by emailing
info@sbwpc.org
Information you give us
Donations.
Our donation form asks for your name, email, street address, phone number, occupation and employer, the amount you give, and anything you add, such as a gift in honor or memory of someone.
Membership.
Our membership form asks for the same contact and occupation details, your membership level, any committees you want to join, who referred you and whether we may email you.
Mailing list.
Our sign-up form asks for your email address and, if you choose, your first and last name.
Endorsement requests.
Candidates who ask for SBWPC's endorsement give us campaign and contact details through our request form.
Messages.
If you email us, we receive your email address and whatever you write.
Information collected automatically
Our web host, Netlify, records basic technical details when you visit, such as your IP address, browser type and the pages you request. This helps keep the site secure and working.

If you agree to analytics cookies, Google Analytics also records how the site is used, such as pages viewed, time on page and general location (city or region). We use this only in summary form to improve the site. See our
Cookie Policy
for details.
How we use your information
To process donations and memberships and send receipts
To meet our legal reporting and record-keeping duties
To send email you asked for, such as news, event invitations and endorsement announcements
To answer your questions and endorsement requests
To run committees, member programs and events
To keep the site secure and understand how it is used
Public reporting of contributions

California law requires political committees to report contributors whose total contributions reach $100 or more. For those contributors we must report your name, street address, occupation, employer (or business name if self-employed), and the date and amount of each contribution. These reports are filed with the state and local filing officers and are public records. Anyone can view them, including online through
Cal-Access
and local filing systems.
Membership dues and donations may both count as contributions. If you have questions about how your gift will be reported, email
info@sbwpc.org
before you give.
Who we share information with
We do not sell, rent, trade or share your personal information or our supporter list
with other organizations, candidates or campaigns, and we do not use it for anyone else's marketing.
We share information only in these cases:
Service providers
that run parts of the site for us, under their own privacy policies:
PayPal
for payments, including Apple Pay
Supabase
for the secure database that holds member and donor records
Constant Contact
for email
Google
for forms, the event calendar and analytics
Netlify
for website hosting and encrypted backups
Government agencies
, as required by the Political Reform Act and other laws, such as campaign finance reports.
When the law requires it
, such as a subpoena or court order, or to protect the safety of our members, the public or SBWPC.
Payments
Payments are processed by PayPal on our Join and Donate pages, including Apple Pay and cards. SBWPC does not receive or store your full card number.
If you choose to mail a check instead, we keep the details you entered so we can match your check when it arrives.
Do Not Track and Global Privacy Control
We do not track visitors across other websites, and we do not allow advertising networks to do so on our site.
If your browser sends a Global Privacy Control or Do Not Track signal, we treat it as a choice to decline analytics cookies. You do not need to do anything else. Learn more at
globalprivacycontrol.org
Some third-party services embedded in our pages, such as the payment buttons or event calendar, set their own cookies to work. They are listed in our
Cookie Policy
How long we keep information

We keep contribution and campaign finance records for as long as the law requires, which is at least four years under California's Political Reform Act. We keep other information only as long as we need it for the purposes above.
[SBWPC to confirm: how long member, mailing list and endorsement request records are kept, and when they are deleted.]
How we protect information

Our site uses encrypted connections (HTTPS). Member and donor records are kept in an access-controlled database. Only SBWPC administrators can open them, and each one signs in with a password and a second verification step. Changes to records are logged, and backups are encrypted. Payments are handled by PayPal under its own security controls. We limit access to supporter records to the people who need it for SBWPC work.
[SBWPC to confirm: who has access to supporter records and the tools they are kept in.]
No system is perfectly secure, so we cannot promise that information will never be exposed. If we learn of a breach that affects you, we will notify you as California law requires.

from our emails at any time using the link at the bottom of every email.
Ask to see
the personal information we hold about you.
Ask us to correct
information that is wrong.

your information. We will delete what we can, but we must keep contribution records the law requires.
Change your cookie choice
at any time using the Cookie settings link at the bottom of every page.
To make a request, email
info@sbwpc.org
or write to us at the address below. We may ask you to confirm your identity. We will respond within 45 days.
[SBWPC to confirm: which officer or volunteer handles privacy requests.]
California privacy rights
California's Consumer Privacy Act applies to for-profit businesses, and SBWPC is not one. We still honor the rights described above for everyone, wherever you live.
Under California's "Shine the Light" law, you may ask whether we share personal information with third parties for their direct marketing. We do not.
Children
This site is not directed to children under 13, and we do not knowingly collect personal information from them. If you believe a child has given us information, email
info@sbwpc.org
and we will delete it.
Links to other websites
Our site links to candidates, government agencies and other organizations. We do not control those sites, and their privacy practices are their own.

What cookies are

Cookies are small files a website saves in your browser. Some are needed for a page or form to work. Others, such as analytics cookies, are optional. Websites can also store small notes in your browser in other ways, such as local storage. This policy covers all of these.
Our choices at a glance

We ask before using analytics cookies. If you say no, they never load.
